newsitem.title: UK: Most Hong Kong stocks up in London, focus on HSBC.
newsitem.headline: Most Hong Kong stocks up in London, focus on HSBC.

text.p: Most Hong Kong shares were slightly firmer in thin trading in London after a strong performance in Hong Kong overnight.
In otherwise featureless dealings, dealers noted continued institutional interest in HSBC Holdings shares, which were up 3.925 to 194.25, having climbed to a record at 194.75 earlier
"HSBC is still commanding a premium in London," said one dealer. "But outside of that, there's nothing going on."
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 5.44 points to 13,525.70 at 14.16 GMT.
In Hong Kong, shares in HSBC led the Hang Seng higher. The benchmark index gained 144.57 points, or 1.1 percent, to 13,520.26.
